Room.title: Classroom Room
Room.description: Shared real-time classroom session keyed by room code.

teacherUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher managing the room, or empty string if unclaimed.

chatPaused.description: Whether student quick phrases and chat messages are temporarily paused by the teacher.

resetEpoch.description: Monotonically increasing counter incremented when the teacher resets confusion signals and ticker.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was last updated.

ConfusionSignal.title: Student Confusion Signal
ConfusionSignal.description: Real-time understanding status of a student terminal within a room.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student terminal.

roomTeacherUid.description: Teacher UID copied from the parent room for query authorization.

anonId.description: Anonymous animal persona name displayed in the classroom.

status.description: Current understanding state of the student.

epoch.description: Room resetEpoch when this signal was emitted.

expiresAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds timestamp when the 45-second confused state auto-expires (0 when understood).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this terminal signal record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this signal was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: Anonymous Classroom Message
ChatMessage.description: Quick phrase or short anonymous question sent by a student.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sender.

roomTeacherUid.description: Teacher UID copied from the parent room for query authorization.

kind.description: Whether the message came from a quick preset button or free-text input.

epoch.description: Room resetEpoch when the message was sent.

resolved.description: Whether the teacher marked this message as addressed/resolved.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was sent.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was last updated.

MutedTerminal.title: Muted Anonymous Terminal
MutedTerminal.description: Terminal muted by the teacher in a specific room.

teacherUid.description: Teacher UID who muted this terminal.

anonId.description: Display anonymous animal name at the time of muting.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the mute was created.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Classroom room configuration and live teacher control state.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Anonymous student chat messages and quick preset reactions.

/rooms/{roomId}/mutes/{terminalId}.description: Terminals muted by the room teacher.
